limitations: Experimental MQTT3.1.1 QoS0/1 subset, not full3.1.1/F5/release conformance. Linux/WSL2 x86_64 only.

One exclusive SQLite database per broker, FULL synchronous DELETE journal, bounded complete JSON image; byte paging replaces proposed record cursors. No WAL/incremental/multiwriter backend or production performance claims.

Durability depends on local filesystem/device fsync and locking. SIGKILL and true SQLite page-limit DiskFull are tested; hardware power-loss, device lying about writes, network filesystem and other platforms are not.
Core serializes commits and retains only one current Store operation receipt; business idempotency ledger is separately fully persisted, bounded and never automatically evicted.

Core image scratch is logically reserved at4x snapshot bound; SQLite/container/runtime/allocator overhead is not an exact RSS limit. Disk budget does not preallocate space or cover external backups/filesystem snapshots.

During host shutdown no new critical CPU/I/O storage promise is created; previously committed armed Wills may be normalized/published on next startup before listen. Runtime normal DISCONNECT still durably removes Will.

Store capability is private host configuration, not a boundary against arbitrary malicious code in the same process; database is not encrypted. Admin audit and Metrics remain memory-only; no dynamic policy/certificate reload.
Private task Cargo cache used to avoid unrelated global Cargo locks. Locked dependency archive hashes verified; no upstream/global configuration modified.
First final auxiliary diff check found Markdown trailing whitespace; fixed and final check passed. Original auxiliary-first-attempt.log retained.

Working tree also contains previous uncommitted security/operations changes. Source hashes capture current cumulative repository input excluding validation evidence; old evidence directories were not modified.
